notes: This is exam lockdown week. Physics HL owns Monday through Thursday. Two full back-to-back simulations early in the week, then targeted drills only on your weakest areas. Do NOT open new topics or do broad review — you are past that. Sunday April 27 is a rest and light notes day only. Everything else (English, Chem, Math, Econ) gets at most 30-45 minutes total this week — just enough to keep them warm. You have prepared. Now execute.
